scope: Tests conducted, B+B1 as defined by DRT122A; England and Wales; not bookings created or future booked appointments
notes: Month labels only: arbitrary stored days within ODS date-formatted labels are not daily test observations.
Missing/suppressed monthly counts are null and are never replaced with zero.
Peak and quietest month only calculated when 12 numeric months reconcile to annual total.
Low annual throughput may reflect an intermittent, specialist, relocated or part-year site.
Annual source excludes some single-examiner centres.
Sampled per-test FOI Annex B has no test date and exactly 1048573 data rows plus 3 header lines; possible spreadsheet row-limit truncation. Not used for timing or volume conclusions.
